summary: Clearmind Medicine filed a Form 6-K attaching an Exhibit 99.1 press release dated September 17, 2026, disclosing that Chief of Global Impact Mary-Elizabeth Gifford testified at an FDA psychedelic hearing held September 14, 2026 in Washington, D.C. No securities transaction, financing, ownership change, or corporate action is described. The release covers clinical and regulatory matters, including patient access commentary and the MEAI alcohol use disorder program studied at Yale and Johns Hopkins. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report of a non-financial operational update; no deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, or timeline appears. Risk-arb angle: none; monitor future clinical and regulatory catalysts only.
